name: fld_card_hyperbola_zmod
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ≠ 2) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) : ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p × ZMod p)).filter (fun v => v.1 ^ 2 - v.2 ^ 2 = a)).card = p - 1
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ≠ 2) (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0), ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p × ZMod p)).filter (fun v => v.1 ^ 2 - v.2 ^ 2 = a)).card = p - 1
informal: For odd p and a ≠ 0 the equation x^2 - y^2 = a has exactly p-1 solutions in F_p — the change of variables u = x+y, v = x-y is a bijection of F_p^2 (2 invertible) turning it into uv = a, whose solutions are (u, a/u) for the p-1 units u.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], p ≠ 2 → ∀ (a : ZMod p), a ≠ 0 → {v | v.1 ^ 2 - v.2 ^ 2 = a}.card = p - 1
